basic_details.job_title: CDM & PHO Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for Medical Officer and Pediatricians Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Chief District Medical & Public Health Office
basic_details.short_information: Chief District Medical & Public Health Office (CDM&PHO) has released the official Medical Officer & Pediatricians Notification 2026 on the official website, https://sundargarh.odisha.gov.in. A total of 3 vacancies have been announced under the CDM&PHO Medical Officer & Pediatricians Recruitment 2026. Eligible candidates who meet the prescribed age limit and educational qualification mentioned in the official notification can submit their offline applications up to 10 August 2026. The official notification PDF and application form are available below.

selection_process: Merit based on length of incumbency
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for CDM & PHO Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://www.bhadrak.odisha.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: CDM & PHO Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available – 1 for Medical Officer (SNCU), 1 for Medical Officer (MBBS-DEIC), and 1 for Pediatricians (DEIC).

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CDM & PHO Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the CDM & PHO Medical Officer posts is 10th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for Medical Officer posts released by the Chief District Medical & Public Health Office.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the official website of CDM & PHO?
faq.answer: The official website of Chief District Medical & Public Health Office is https://www.bhadrak.odisha.gov.in.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the CDM & PHO recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts is based on merit, determined by the length of incumbency.

faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 18/2026.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for contractual posts.

faq.question: Q9. Which district is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for the Bhadrak district in Odisha.

faq.answer: The specific posts include Medical Officer (SNCU), Medical Officer (MBBS-DEIC), and Pediatricians (DEIC).
